entities.summary: Viasat History is a pay television channel owned by the International media company, Viasat World LTD. The channel broadcasts history series from around the world with a focus on the ancient world, historical drama, royal history, travel history and religious history. Viasat History is a 24-hour channel, broadcasting in Central and Eastern Europe, The Baltics, Turkey, and Israel.
